title: leucanthemum kurilense
intro: Leucanthemum kurilense, commonly known as the Kurile daisy, is a flowering plant species within the daisy family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of the Kurile daisy include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Leucanthemum kurilense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
